findings.what: PRIVATE-LB READ PLAN (light API load; extends R41-A7 and PRIVATE-READ v2 (d)). WHEN: there is no host statement (744250 questions from kostopr4v, 02:00 UTC, and Selina Wu are unanswered). In a code competition every scored submission already carries a hidden privateScore, so the reveal is administrative. Kaggle usually flips within ~0-3 h of the deadline, sometimes a day later ('being finalized'). CADENCE: 00:07Z = R41-A7: one 'timeout 180 python tools/uptest.py save final_0007Z', one read_selected, and one submissions list; stop lb_poll.py. Then 1 LB download per hour at :07 (priv_0107Z ... priv_0607Z). After 06:07Z, every 3 h until 30 Sep 18:07Z, then stop and ask the user. Total <= ~12 calls. PUBLIC vs PRIVATE TEST, per download: (i) the zip member name. post_exp75's is 'biohub-cell-tracking-during-development-publicleaderboard-2026-09-29T09:08:57.csv', so print zf.namelist(); 'private' in the name = private. (ii) Score-drop test against the FULL zip post_exp75 (N 3 991; NOT e10_1141Z, which holds 1 006 rows): count TeamIds present in both whose Score is lower now. Public bests never fall, so 0 drops and our Score 0.959 (or 0.960+ after an exp89t promotion) = PUBLIC; >= 20 drops or our Score below our public best = PRIVATE; anything else = AMBIGUOUS, wait an hour. ON THE FLIP: 1 submissions list with --page-size 100 (the privateScore column is filled; lb_poll's format already carries it) and 1 read_selected that also prints s.private_score. Then stop all calls. MEDAL LINES from N = all rows of the private CSV, per Kaggle's >= 1000-team rule: gold <= 10 + floor(0.002N), silver <= floor(0.05N), bronze <= floor(0.10N) (N 3 991 -> 17/199/399; N ~4 005 -> 18/200/400). USER MESSAGE (MSK first): 'Приватный ЛБ открыт (ЧЧ:ММ МСК, ЧЧ:ММ UTC): мы #R из N, приват X; зона: <золото/серебро/бронза/без медали> (линии: золото ≤ G, серебро ≤ S, бронза ≤ B; до чистки Kaggle, после снятия нарушителей место может подняться). Финалы: exp87a 56640366 приват a, #37 56563521 приват b; в зачёт идёт лучший из двух. Для справки: exp89t приват d; лучший приват среди всех наших файлов c (не выбран).'
